title: Projects
myNodesHint: Manage node versions published to the current workspace marketplace, {{count}} total.
myFlowsHint: Manage flow snippets published to the current workspace marketplace, {{count}} total.
filterResult: Filter result: {{count}} items (matching title, description, path and tags)
archivedHint: Archived pipelines can still be opened and edited; files are located in the _archived subdirectory of each pipelines directory.
activeHint: Manage your distributed node architectures and monitoring pipelines. Drag flow.yaml or .zip into this page to import shared flows.
nodesHint: Review all globally available node definitions, {{count}} total, including built-in, workspace, and marketplace nodes.
skillsHint: Review Composer-selectable skills, {{count}} total, including AgentFlow built-ins and workspace skills.
nodesPurposeTitle: Executable building blocks for pipeline runtime
nodesPurposeDesc: Nodes define what can be placed on the canvas, which inputs and outputs exist, and whether runtime behavior is agent, control, provide, or marketplace logic.
myNodesPurposeDesc: Only node versions published to this workspace marketplace appear here. Inspect details and delete versions that no flow uses.
myFlowsPurposeDesc: Flow snippets published from Pipeline or Workspace canvases appear here. Search and inspect them, then load them from the canvas flow palette.
skillsPurposeTitle: Operating guides for Composer and agents
skillsPurposeDesc: Skills tell AI which rules to follow for a task, how to change flows, and how to reuse project conventions.
noActive: No active pipelines; archived items are in the Archived tab.
noMyNodes: No marketplace nodes have been published.
noMyFlows: No flow snippets have been published. Select multiple canvas nodes and publish them first.
binaryFile: Binary file preview is not supported.

noNodeUsage: No pipelines using this node were found.
deleteMyNodeHint: AgentFlow checks all flow references before deleting; installed or used versions are kept.
nodesMeaning: This node is an execution unit in a pipeline. Its schema affects canvas wiring, parameter input, and runtime scheduling.
myFlowsMeaning: A flow snippet is a reusable part of a fixed workflow. Loading it copies its nodes, edges, and layout into the current canvas without replacing existing content.
skillsMeaning: This skill is injected into Composer as context for AI, constraining its decisions, edit strategy, and output format.
selectResource: Select a resource to inspect details.

hubCard.title: Browse community flows
hubCard.desc: Discover and install ready-made pipelines shared by the community.
hubCard.cliHint: Or install via CLI: agentflow download <slug>

newPipelineModal.title: Create New Pipeline
newPipelineModal.lead: Enter a pipeline name (English identifier); description is optional and will be saved in flow's ui.description.
newPipelineModal.nameHint: Must start with a letter, only letters, numbers, underscores _ and hyphens - allowed
newPipelineModal.descPlaceholder: Briefly describe the purpose of this pipeline...

importModal.title: Import Pipeline
importModal.lead: File "{{filename}}" selected. Please confirm the pipeline name and save location; ZIP will preserve scripts and other files in the directory.
importModal.nameHint: Must start with a letter, only letters, numbers, underscores _ and hyphens - allowed

deleteModal.title: Delete Pipeline
deleteModal.lead: This will permanently delete the pipeline directory from disk (including flow.yaml, scripts, etc.) and cannot be undone. Please enter the pipeline ID "{{flowId}}" below to confirm.
deleteModal.deleteTimeout: Delete request timed out, please retry (check UI service logs in terminal)

archiveModal.title: Archive Pipeline
archiveModal.lead: After archiving, the pipeline will be moved to the "Archived" list and can still be opened and edited from there. Please enter the pipeline ID "{{flowId}}" below to confirm.
